   - (Euromaidan, start time, 21 November 2013) with qualifier maybe "point in time" but start time is date.
   - Also location: Maidan Nezalezhnosti (place) and Kiev (city). Could have two location relations: (Euromaidan, location, Maidan Nezalezhnosti) and (Maidan Nezalezhnosti, located in, Kiev). But maybe include (Euromaidan, location, Maidan Nezalezhnosti) and also (Maidan Nezalezhnosti, location, Kiev). Provide both.

But maybe keep one: (Ukrainian government, chose, closer ties to Russia) and (... to Eurasian Economic Union). We'll make two.
